title: Loop Engineering: Stop Babysitting Your AI Coder
description:
Big names in tech stopped prompting their AI line by line. Instead of re-prompting and babysitting every step, they set up a loop: give the AI one clear goal and a finish line, then let it run and fix its own mistakes until the goal is met.

That is loop engineering. The whole thing lives or dies on the finish line, something the AI can actually check (a passing test, a clean build), so it knows when it is truly done.

I put together examples of good goal structures so your finish line is one Claude can verify. The link is on my channel.

#claudecode #ai #vibecoding #aicoding #loopengineering
